user.title: Librus Synergia (unofficial)
user.description: Log in with your Librus login (e.g. "1234567u") and password. This uses Librus's private web API and may violate Librus's Terms of Service - use your own account at your own risk. Your session normally expires after about a day with no way to silently renew it without your password, so - unlike some integrations - your password IS stored (alongside the session) to allow unattended daily refresh; it never leaves your Home Assistant instance.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Librus Synergia
reauth_confirm.description: The saved session for {login} could not be renewed. Enter the password again to log in.

error.invalid_auth: Login was rejected. Check the login/password.
error.captcha_needed: Librus is asking for a captcha, which this integration cannot solve automatically. Try again later, or log in once via the official Librus app/website first.
error.account_action_required: Your Librus account needs an action on Librus's own site first (accept rules, or change your password), then try again.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Librus servers.

abort.already_configured: This Librus account is already configured.

data_description.scan_interval: How often to refresh grades, attendance, timetable and announcements. Keep this modest - it is an unofficial API.
